blocks.desc: Seriously. You land at 10:55 AM and go straight to a connection, then a driver, then dinner. The guy who watches four movies is the guy who dies on Friday.

trivia.a: An Airbus A380 — the double-decker superjumbo. Business class is upstairs.

trivia.a: Six. Dallas is UTC−5, London is UTC+1 in summer.

trivia.q: We take off at 7:40 PM and land at 10:55 AM. How long is the flight actually?
trivia.a: About nine hours. The other six are the clock jumping ahead.

blocks.desc: Steaks. Prinsengracht.

blocks.title: LuminAir rooftop — again
blocks.desc: Walk in, no booking. Open until 2 AM on Thursdays. If the vibe's good we stay all night.

suggestions.title: Wildcard: Canvas @ Volkshotel
suggestions.desc: 7th floor, free DJ night on Thursdays. Good second stop if LuminAir dies.

trivia.q: The tour starts at the National Monument on Dam Square. What does it commemorate?
trivia.a: Dutch victims of the Second World War. Unveiled in 1956.

trivia.q: Restaurant BLACK is on the Prinsengracht. What does that canal name mean?
trivia.a: Prince's Canal — one of the three main rings, along with Herengracht and Keizersgracht.

trivia.q: What are those hooks sticking out of the top of Amsterdam's canal houses for?
trivia.a: Hoisting furniture up through the windows. The staircases are far too narrow.

days.subtitle: The reason this trip has a date on it.

blocks.title: Lunch · Foodhallen
blocks.desc: Converted tram depot in Oud-West. 19 stalls — The Butcher burgers, Holy Fried Chicken, ramen, tacos, pizza, three bars. €8–16 a plate.
blocks.warn: OPENS 12:00 SHARP, walk-in only. Be there right at noon and send ONE guy to claim a table immediately.

blocks.title: Van Gogh Museum
blocks.desc: Timed entry.

trivia.q: The Black Keys are a two-piece from which Ohio city?
trivia.a: Akron. Dan Auerbach and Patrick Carney, together since 2001.

trivia.q: The Van Gogh Museum holds the largest collection of his work anywhere. Roughly how many paintings?
trivia.a: About 200 paintings, plus around 500 drawings and 750 letters.

trivia.q: AFAS Live opened in 2001 under a different, beer-sponsored name. What was it?
trivia.a: The Heineken Music Hall.

trivia.q: The Devonshire in Soho is famous for pouring one drink above all others. What?

trivia.q: Where does the name 'Mayfair' come from?

blocks.warn: Leave by 11:45.

trivia.q: The Wolseley's dining room was built in 1921 for a completely different purpose. What?

trivia.q: Sexy Fish's dining room features work by which British artist, best known for a shark in formaldehyde?
trivia.a: Damien Hirst.

trivia.q: How many rooms does Buckingham Palace have?
trivia.a: 775 — including 78 bathrooms.

items.label: UK ETA — apply NOW
items.desc: All three of us need one to enter the UK. £20. Apply in the official "UK ETA" app or on gov.uk — avoid third-party sites that charge more. Approval usually within ~3 working days. Valid 2 years / multiple trips. ONE ETA covers both the Aug 26–27 Heathrow connection AND the Sep 5–8 London stay.
items.warn: Do not leave this to the last week.

items.label: Passport check
items.desc: Must be valid at least 3 months beyond Sep 8, 2026 — so through ~Dec 8, 2026. Six months is the safe standard. Must ALSO have been issued within the last 10 years.

items.label: No-foreign-transaction-fee card + Apple Pay set up
items.desc: Europe is tap-to-pay everywhere. Denmark is effectively cashless.

items.label: Tell your bank you're traveling
items.desc: Four countries in 14 days will trip fraud detection otherwise.

items.label: Photo/copy of passport saved to your phone
items.desc: Screenshot it. Also email it to yourself.

items.label: Global Entry / Mobile Passport for the DFW return
items.desc: Makes Sep 8 painless — especially if there's a watch to declare.

items.label: Prescriptions in original bottles + enough for 14 days
items.desc: Original labelled bottles. Bring a few days extra in case of delays.

items.label: One smart night-out outfit
items.desc: Volksgarten (Vienna, Fri Aug 28) is a proper club — collared and clean-shoed, not sneakers-and-shorts. Doors run on discretion. Sexy Fish (London, Sun Sep 6) also bans sneakers and caps. One good outfit covers both.

items.label: TWO adapter types — C/F and G
items.desc: Europe Type C/F for Vienna, Copenhagen and Amsterdam. Type G for London. A universal adapter covers both — bring one each.

items.label: Portable battery pack
items.desc: This site + maps + photos will drain your phone by mid-afternoon every day.

items.label: Layers + a light rain jacket
items.desc: Early September runs ~60–72°F. Copenhagen and Amsterdam get roughly one rainy day in three.

items.label: Comfortable walking shoes
items.desc: Four walking tours and a lot of pavement. Your feet will decide how much you enjoy this.

items.desc: Phone, watch, battery pack. Count them.

items.desc: For the walking tours and museum days.
